desc:
[FULL RELEASE] V1

Drift and drive through the endless Backrooms! 🚗
Earn Drift Points from smooth slides or collect points scattered across the map. 💨

Create your very own custom maps that other users can explore & drift around in. 🗺️

Purchase new cars with unique speeds and sounds from the shop! 🏎️
Tandem drift with others or explore the Backrooms solo! 🌀

expect bugs and problems, if so report them via my group tagged down below ⚠

-- CONTROLS --
W, A, S, D - Movement
LCtrl / □ / B  - Handbrake
Shift + P - Freecam
F / △ / Y - First Person
